law: DEL-04-03/REQ-014 and DEL-04-11/REQ-014: spring of the entered rate on its declared translational DOF plus the entered cold load as a constant force along +DOF at the support's node in every case; published support force F_cold - k*(u - g) (g = 0: no case moves the hanger's base); the cold load published separately as the support's applied force; installed_load and hot_load not applied

conventions.reactions: support-on-pipe, global, Fx Fy Fz Mx My Mz (the frozen convention); a variable spring hanger's row is F_cold - k u on its DOF

conventions.criteria: unchanged: the frozen file's criterion of each case applies
